newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Chancellor Q2 net loss widens.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Chancellor Q2 net loss widens.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Chancellor Corp said its net income for the second quarter and the first six months of 1997 includes an extraordinary gain of $930,000, or 0.05 per share, for the early extinguishment of debt.

The company said the loss in the second quarter of 1997 occurred primarily as a result of an accounting charge related to the issuance of approximately 15,000,000 shares of common stock to secure new financing and to pay off restructuring debt.

The company said the loss in the first six months of 1997 is primarily attributable to restructuring, litigation expenses and a reduction in its residual value estimate that was recorded in the first quarter.
